Container.Name: SumOffice
Container.Overview: SumOffice adds Excel- and Word-compatible browser editors to Nextcloud Office and other WOPI hosts: SumSheet for workbooks (.xlsx, .xlsm, .xlsb; VBA kept) at /f1 and SumDoc for documents (.docx) at /a4, with a joint WOPI discovery at /hosting/discovery, all on one port.[br][br] After install: in Nextcloud open Administration settings, Office, "Use your own server" and enter the Public URL below. Put a TLS reverse proxy (with WebSocket support) in front of the port if Nextcloud uses https.[br][br] Needs about 2 GB RAM plus about 250 MB per open document. The image is free for evaluation; production use inside an organisation is licensed per application: https://sumoffice.com/download#server
Container.Requires: A WOPI host such as Nextcloud with the Nextcloud Office (richdocuments) app. Disable any Collabora server connected to the same Nextcloud Office app.

Config.Name: Editor port
Config.Description: Port of the editors and the WOPI discovery.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Editor workspace and the WOPI proof key shared by both editors.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Address the browser uses to reach the editors, with scheme and without a trailing slash (for example https://office.example.com).

Config.Name: WOPI host name
Config.Description: Host name of your Nextcloud (the file storage allowed to open files), without scheme. Passed to SumSheet as --wopi-allow.

Config.Name: WOPI host URL
Config.Description: Full origin of the same Nextcloud (for example https://cloud.example.com). Empty means https://[WOPI host name]. Passed to SumDoc as --wopi-hosts.

Config.Name: Open documents per editor
Config.Description: Each open document is one process of about 250 MB RAM.
